text: Program Description Introduction of TEFL program What is TEFL? TEFL stands for Teaching English as a Foreign Language. TEFL courses will equip you with the skills and confidence that you need to teach English as a foreign Language. Who is Eligible? Anybody is able to take our 120 hour online TEFL course. This program provides learners with elevated experiences and the tools required to engage and inspire future learners in English classrooms around the world. Internationally recognized, the program is certification authenticated in collaboration with a licensed from USA IAO . The online TEFL training is designed to assist teachers with the first step towards an exciting International teaching position. Where Can TEFL be Appl ied for ? TEFL is predominately taught in countries where English isn’t the native language. Opportunities commonly exist in schools and language institutes, but you will also find opportunities for private tutoring, corporate businesses, volunteering and online learning. Curriculum Unit 1: Language Acquisition Unit 2: Skills Unit 3: Teaching Grammar and Vocabulary Unit 4: Classroom Management Unit 5: Assessing Student Levels Unit 6: Modern Methods Unit 7: Demo Lesson It has been written by a Aussie Born TEFL expert and is designed for those first time teachers to equip you with what you need to get the knowledge and confidence to teach for the first time. It is one of the most up to date TEFL courses out there. Study Duration 120 hours training you have 180 days to complete. Completely online, so you can do it around other commitments. Once you have registered you can start learning immediately. Real life tutor support, our tutors are available throughout the week. Receive your certificate automatically after completion.
